notes: Minutes after 5.66.0 the owner reported it: "the following menu items are not retrieving a response: Reach, Conditions, Rules, Strategies, Events, firing, runs, backtests, processes." Nine panels — every one of the nine that had moved from Administration to Analysis — rendered nothing at all. Each of those renderers fetches, then guards its callback with "am I still the visible panel?" before painting. That guard is right: it stops a late response painting over a surface the reader has since left. What was wrong was the QUESTION. Every call site asked adminActive(id), which is state.active ===
